question_cn: 消除保护时，有时需要以大换小（例如以车换象）。这种牺牲值得的条件是什么？
question_en: When removing a defender requires a favorable exchange, such as a rook for a bishop, when is the sacrifice worthwhile?

options.text_cn: 只要能吃掉保护者就值得，不管后续结果
options.text_en: It is worthwhile whenever you can capture the defender, regardless of what follows

options.text_cn: 只有在双方子力完全相等时才允许牺牲
options.text_en: A sacrifice is only allowed when both sides have equal material

options.text_cn: 消除保护者后，所获得的目标棋子（或将杀机会）的价值，必须超过牺牲的子力
options.text_en: The value of the target or mating attack gained after removing the defender must exceed the sacrificed material

options.text_cn: 牺牲前必须确保己方还剩足够的兵力守卫国王
options.text_en: Before sacrificing, make sure you still have enough pawns to guard your king

explanation_cn: 消除保护中的牺牲必须经过价值核算：如果以车（5分）吃掉保护者象（3分），亏了2分，但随后能吃到一个后（9分）或实施将杀（无价），则总收益远超损失，牺牲完全合理。核心公式：牺牲价值 < 目标价值 + 位置/将杀收益。盲目牺牲而不计后果，是初学者常见的错误。
explanation_en: Evaluate the material balance before sacrificing. Giving up a rook (5 points) for a bishop (3 points) loses two points, but it can be justified if removing the defender wins a queen (9 points) or forces checkmate. The key is that the value of the target and positional or mating gains must exceed the sacrifice.
